title: BotProactiveSettings v1
description: The effective proactive-delivery configuration. The persisted ProactiveSettings blob supplies mode/dnd/quietStart/quietEnd/routineQuietWeekends/timeZone; ProactivePolicyConfiguration supplies fuseWindowMs/fuseMaxWakeups; ProactiveEngine supplies deliveryKinds. A canonical writer emits all nine members and no others. quietStart/quietEnd are local clock times; one-digit hours are accepted because QuietClock.minutes accepts them, but canonical writers emit HH:MM. See spec/bot/v2/README.md §3.

mode.description: off stops at mode-off after the routine held/quiet pre-filter; would records would decisions without delivery; on delivers kinds listed in deliveryKinds.

quietStart.description: Local quiet-window start. QuietClock.minutes trims the value, requires an hour of at most two digits and a two-digit minute, and accepts 0..23 / 0..59. Canonical writers emit HH:MM.

quietEnd.description: Local quiet-window end, same grammar as quietStart. quietStart == quietEnd means no quiet window (RoutineQuietHours.isWithinQuietHours returns false).

timeZone.description: IANA time-zone identifier. ProactiveSettings.normalized replaces an identifier TimeZone(identifier:) cannot resolve with TimeZone.current.identifier.

fuseWindowMs.description: Frequency-fuse window. ProactivePolicyConfiguration defaults to 900000. The comparison is strict: now - acceptedAt < fuseWindowMs.

fuseMaxWakeups.description: Maximum did/would contributions per Bot per window. ProactivePolicyConfiguration defaults to 4; with that default the 4th contribution is allowed and the next candidate is refused with reason fuse.

deliveryKinds.description: Kinds ProactiveEngine may deliver when mode == on. Other kinds are still considered and record a would decision with reason would-only-kind, but consume no fuse. An empty array is valid (deliver nothing in on mode).
